title: Pain points
description: The friction that makes each reference setup hard for a newcomer to replicate, and what Open House does instead. This file is the negative half of the corpus: the other files record what the four setups do, and this one records what they make people do. `our_answer` is required to name a downstream phase, which is what keeps an observation from being filed as a wish.

repo.description: The repo the friction was observed in. Every one of the four contributes at least one entry: a pain point only one setup has is still a pain point, and a register that drew only on the best-documented repo would answer the wrong question.

friction.description: What the setup makes hard, in our own words.

why_hard.description: Why it is hard, which is the part that decides whether our answer addresses the cause or only the symptom.

our_answer.description: What Open House does instead, naming the downstream phase that will do it. Required and non-empty: an unanswered pain point is a complaint, and the phase name is what makes it assignable.
